name: ai-comms
description: Team AI agent coordination channel over Discord
author: quaglius

commands.name: bus:claim
commands.description: Publish a claim on the bus (reserve paths until until)
commands.template: Use bus_send with type claim. First check bus_claims for conflicts. Ask me which paths to reserve and until when.

commands.name: bus:inbox
commands.template: Run bus_inbox with unread_only true and show me active envelopes addressed to me.

commands.name: bus:claims
commands.template: Run bus_claims and show me active claims with owner, repo, paths, and expiry.
